trust_center.repositoryDescription: The Certification Package Overview and the Security Decision Record (each in PDF and JSON); the SOC 2 Type II report, the bridge letter, and the engagement letter for the 2026 examination; Ongoing Certification Reports; simulated Initial, Ongoing, and Final Incident Reports; the nine policies listed in the Certification Package Overview; the FedRAMP Certification Profile and Program Selection record; the FedRAMP Agency Use Case record; and the three Quarterly Review procedures. All are available through the Trust Center on request.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Request access on the Trust Center landing page (https://trust.factory.com). Requests from fedramp.gov and gsa.gov email addresses are approved without manual review and need no non-disclosure agreement.

current.service_desc:
Factory is an autonomous software engineering platform for U.S. federal agencies and contractors. Factory for Government is the FedRAMP version of the Factory Enterprise Platform.

Factory's agents, called Droids, take engineering work such as tickets, alerts, and vulnerability findings, then plan, write, test, and review code through the agency's existing pipelines. Engineers set goals and approve what ships. Organization-wide controls govern which models and tools Droids can use, Droids run in isolated sandboxes, and every action is recorded in an exportable audit log.
